title: Bereikbaarheid algemene ziekenhuizen in de provincie Gelderland 1980
authors: Vries, A. de, Vries, J. de (primary investigator)
contributors: NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den Haag (data collector)
descriptions: Development of criteria representative for the province of Gelderland on the attainability of hospitals, especially as it is experienced by visitors. Distance in time between residence and hospital / r's opinion about the attainability of the hospital / number of possible visits per day. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ place of work
